goal: Add --runtime flag to gad projects init. Default 'claude' — the most-used runtime. Comma-separated for multiple ('claude,gemini'). Known: claude, cursor, gemini, opencode, codex, none. AGENTS.md + .planning/AGENTS.md remain always-written base targets; the selected runtime layers its entrypoint (CLAUDE.md from template, .cursorrules / GEMINI.md / .opencode/AGENTS.md generated as thin pointer-back-to-AGENTS.md bodies). codex+none skip the extra entrypoint entirely. Unknown runtimes are rejected with a list of known values. Default behavior unchanged from a consumer perspective — claude entrypoint still written by default.
